content_sections.heading: Location of Vacancies
content_sections.text: The vacancies are distributed among ECHS polyclinics at the following locations: Anantapur Chittoor Eluru Giddalur Golconda Guntur Kadapa Karimnagar Khammam Kurnool Mahabubnagar Nellore Sainikpuri Secunderabad-I Secunderabad-II Vijayawada

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Scrutiny of applications and supporting documents Written test for candidates meeting the qualitative requirements Interview for candidates who qualify in the written test Final selection based on overall merit The written test date, time and venue will be communicated to accepted applicants through email. No travelling allowance or daily allowance will be paid for attending the selection process.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Self-attested photocopies of the applicable documents must be attached to the application: Educational qualification certificates and marksheets Work experience certificates Registration certificate for Medical and Paramedical posts Discharge book, where applicable Pension Payment Order, where applicable Candidates must bring the original certificates, service records, PAN card, Aadhaar card and two passport-size colour photographs at the time of the selection process.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ECHS Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official ECHS website at www.echs.gov.in. Open the Employment Opportunities section. Download the prescribed application form. Complete the application with accurate personal and qualification details. Attach self-attested photocopies of all applicable documents. Send the completed application to the prescribed address before the deadline. Officer-in-Charge Station HQ ECHS Cell, HQ TASA Near Rashtrapati Nilayam Secunderabad - 500010 Telangana The completed application must reach the office by 4 October 2026 at 6:00 PM . Online applications and applications submitted through email will not be accepted.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applications received after the deadline will not be accepted. Incomplete applications or applications containing incorrect documents will not be considered for the written test or interview. Only candidates meeting the prescribed qualitative requirements will be called for the written test. Only written-test-qualified candidates will be called for the interview. Final selection will be based on overall merit. Selected candidates must undergo ten days of on-the-job training without pay and allowances.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in ECHS Telangana and Andhra Pradesh Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 96 Medical, Paramedical and Non-Medical vacancies.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The completed application must reach the prescribed office by 4 October 2026 at 6:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. Online applications and applications sent by email will not be accepted.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary range?
faq.answer: The monthly salary ranges from Rs.21,800 to Rs.1,30,000, depending on the post.

faq.question: Q5. How many Medical Officer vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are 22 Medical Officer vacancies carrying a monthly salary of Rs.95,000.

faq.question: Q6. What is the qualification for Medical Officer?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for Medical Officer must possess an MBBS degree.

faq.question: Q7. What is the contract period?
faq.answer: The contract period is 12 months for ex-servicemen and widows of deceased soldiers and 11 months for civilian candidates.
